intro.fallback: In the future, an older Boruto fights Kawaki in a destroyed Konohagakure and argue about the end of the age of shinobi.
Both activate seal-like powers, Boruto activates a dōjutsu in his right eye, and both resume their fight.
In the present, Boruto and Shikadai run through Konoha.

outro.fallback: On top of a train, Boruto celebrates being able to buy a limited-edition chili burger.
As they eat the two comment on the village's modernisation, and Shikadai scoffs at the prospect of having to attend the Academy.
